observations: R1 performs no Editor.Regen on any view branch.

In R1 the library import (WblockCloneObjects) runs inside the same document lock as the definition create, but outside any RackCad transaction; in R2/R3 placement the import runs under a separate lock (RackViewPlacement.cs:74) released before CreatePreparedBlock takes its own lock.

In R3 the DeferToFirstPlacement disposition is executed by EditSelective as an immediate Mutate+Post (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:182-188) before the batch; SelectiveInsertPort.Place (RackSelectivoInsertIntegration.cs:166-196, the beforeCommit variant) is not invoked by EditSelective.
R3 sibling Prepare can clone library definitions (EnsureForPlan) under L_prepare before the mutate transaction exists; those clones are not rolled back if the later mutate is Discarded.
Batch placements (R2/R3) are independent committed units; a later cancel/failure does not erase earlier placed views.
SystemBlockWriter.CreatePreparedBlock failure yields DefinitionFailed with no Cleanup call; the transaction is aborted by dispose.
